title: Person: Dedalus
html_source:
This passage is marked in the Open Editions semantic edition as a person name.

Dedalus

anchor.prefix:
d Simon Moonan was knotting his false sleeves. He was telling them something about Tullabeg.

 Then he went away from the door and Wells came over to Stephen and said:

 —Tell us,
anchor.suffix:
, do you kiss your mother before you go to bed?

 Stephen answered:

 —I do.

 Wells turned to the other fellows and said:

 —O, I say, here’s a fellow says he kisses his mother ev
